war_guy.speaker: System
lines: You were out cold for a bit there lets get back to it
what do you mean you dont know where you are?
Grab the gun I left it over to your right
Just dont let them reach us thats it
Well what do we have here...
You are not meant to be here....

guy_at_table.speaker: Someone You Should Know
lines: Let me tell you a story.
This story begins in a beautiful place.... #(beach transition start)#
A place where the very tide would pull you in..... #(freeze on beach wind noise, birds, sun, water, go back to table after a few seconds record scratch)#
Scratch that terrible way to start...
This story starts in a city...
A city unlike anything you will find on this planet #(city transition here for short time before back to table)#
Damn! #shake# why is it so hard to just start this! #deep breath#
Let's do this one more time... #(house transition)#
This is what I would call 'home' at least thats what it was...
#text size small# Up until the very thing that brought you here existed to the public...
#text becomes mostly clear as you 'load' into this world# I wish i still had the chance to say goodbye...
